    public void solve() throws IOException {

        long tWays = 0;
        ways[0][0] = 1;

            ways[i][0] = ways[i - 1][1];
            ways[i][n] = ways[i - 1][n - 1];

            }

                    tWays = (tWays + ways[i][k]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(tWays);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        new NekoAndAkiPrank().solve();
    }
}
